description: This file defines the ReviewSearchController class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically for handling performance review search functionality. It extends a base controller, adds date-related properties for the review search component, and utilizes traits for date-time helpers.

classes.name: ReviewSearchController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the review search interface in the performance module, generating date filters for the Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the review search component with date properties before rendering.

methods.name: addFromToDateProps
methods.description: Adds 'from-date' and 'to-date' properties to the Vue component, defaulting to the current year.
